refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
refresh_minutes.description: How often the CLI is asked for fresh usage. Countdowns tick locally between calls.

vendor.label: Provider
vendor.description: Which plan this capsule tracks. Add the widget twice to watch two.

style.label: Style
style.description: How this capsule looks in the bar.

show_name.label: Show provider name
show_name.description: Adds the product name next to the percentage, so two capsules do not look alike.

color_by_usage.label: Color by usage
color_by_usage.description: Primary while there is room, then amber, then red as the quota fills.

provider_limit.label: Providers in the capsule
provider_limit.description: How many providers one capsule shows, busiest first, with a +N for the rest. Only applies when the provider is Automatic.

extras.label: Extra reading
extras.description: What rides next to the percentage: the time left in the window, how far the spend is from the clock, or neither.

ui.title: AI Usage
ui.hidden_value: {count} more, click to open the panel
